zh.title: Meteomatics發表新高空氣象無人機Strato 可爬升至4245英尺
zh.summary: 瑞士Meteomatics發表Strato無人機；可爬升至4245英尺蒐集氣象資料
body: 瑞士氣象情報公司Meteomatics於2026年10月8日發表新型氣象無人機Strato。依據AeroTime報導，該公司專注於氣象情報領域。
Strato是一款小型多旋翼無人機，可爬升至4,245英尺（10,438公尺）高度，在高對流層區域（商業航班通常巡航的大氣層部分）蒐集氣象資料。相比氣象氣球，無人機在移動方面更為靈活，可捕捉天氣劇烈變化。
Meteomatics表示，Strato與同類無人機不同，具耐高低溫與風能力，可承受最高每小時80英里的持續風，並能主動調節方向迎風飛行，同時配備加熱系統以防止旋翼結冰。
該公司指出，這些無人機蒐集的資料用於其超精密氣象預報，在歐洲及北美多數地區可精確至1平方公里。Meteomatics表示，這些無人機收集的資料用於其超精密氣象預報，並將相關比喻說明引用自共同創辦人兼執行長馬丁·斐格拉（Martin Fengler）。截至2026年10月上旬，該公司約有800家客戶。

en.title: Meteomatics unveils new high-altitude drone Strato designed for harsh weather data gathering
en.summary: Swiss firm Meteomatics unveils Strato drone; reaches 4,245 feet to collect meteorological data.
body: Swiss weather intelligence firm Meteomatics unveiled a new meteorological drone named Strato on October 8, 2026. It is a small multicopter drone capable of climbing to altitudes of up to 4,245 feet (10,438 meters) to collect meteorological data in the upper troposphere.

Strato is engineered to withstand rough conditions at high altitudes. It is waterproof, can withstand sustained winds up to 80 mph, and actively orient itself into headwinds. It is fitted with a heating system to prevent the icing of the rotors.

With this drone, Meteomatics aims to fill a gap in meteorological data collection between ground-based stations and meteorological balloons. The data is used in the firm's ultra-granular weather forecasts, which in most of Europe and North America can be for an area as precise as 1 square km.
According to co-founder and CEO Martin Fengler, the company has around 800 customers using its weather forecasts as of early October 2026.
